snippet.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2 on October 22, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/nintendo-switch-sports-resort-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Square off against Island Champions in the brand-new Island Crown mode, stylize your Mii Character or Sportsmate, collect Spocco Photos from sightseeing spots, freely explore the island—and more!

Why not take a break and enjoy this charming resort?

#NintendoDirect #NintendoSwitchSportsResort 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
